text:
Miriam K: Quick design sync I uploaded a lightweight prototype for prompt-set compare + approval modal: https://www.figma.com/file/newproto. Aim: make regressions obvious without clutter, tighten CTA copy for keyboard users, and confirm a11y basics (focus, aria). PTAL.

Devin R: Two immediate things: the deletion red on the diff layer fails AA on white; will propose two swaps in Figma comments. Also add an obvious focus ring for diff rows.

Ash Patel: Accessibility checklist: make each diff row a semantic button with aria-expanded and a visually-hidden summary like "Regression test X down 12%". Add an aria-live region for new diffs but debounce updates so SR users aren't spammed.

Miriam K: Modal copy draft: header: "Approve prompt set"; body: "Promoting this set will apply it to selected model variants. Add optional reviewer notes." Buttons: visual primary "Approve & Promote" but programmatic label "Promote" for compact contexts/shortcuts; secondary "Request changes"; inline small expand for "Approve with notes".

Sam O'Neill: PM ask: surface a condensed scorecard in the modal header (pass % and regression delta) and include keyboard shortcuts: A=Promote, R=Request changes, N=Notes. Show shortcuts in footer help text.

DesignBot: regression-bot: Alert: prompt-set 301  2 regressions, avg delta -9%. Report: https://dash/reports/301

Devin R: I'll add color swatches (#b02a37 and #9b2330) and a focus CSS example in the figma comments: `.diff-row:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 2px; }`

Ash Patel: I'll draft ARIA snippets and a short QA script (keyboard-only + screen reader checks). Notes expansion must be reachable by 'N' and must not trap focus. Use role="dialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby pointing to the condensed scorecard.

Miriam K: Decisions: (1) swap deletion red to a higher-contrast option from Devin; (2) condensed scorecard in modal header; (3) visual CTA text stays "Approve & Promote" but programmatic label = "Promote" with shortcut 'A'; (4) inline expandable notes under CTA; (5) diff rows focusable and announced. Action owners: @Devin R colors + CSS, @Ash Patel ARIA + QA, @Sam O'Neill acceptance criteria + data examples, @Miriam K update prototype. Target: interactive staging next week. :thumbsup:
